The c18442a fee build remained unready because eight tokens across four quiet markets emitted byte-identical full-book recovery payloads that the content-addressed event identity correctly deduplicated but therefore could not close the durable connection gap.

Independent upstream checks showed REST /book HTTP 200 with two-sided books for all eight tokens, independent WS subscriptions received 8/8 for those tokens and 200/200 for the full scope; the defect was local recovery identity binding, not missing upstream books.

The first recovery patch was too broad and failed marketcow-runtime::tests::repeated_upstream_snapshot_is_an_idempotent_noop by making every repeated full book unique. Commit 9e76d53 scopes identity rebinding only to duplicate full books for tokens with an unresolved durable gap; ordinary repeats remain idempotent.

Earlier HTTP soak and stability-verifier failures remain preserved in their original artifacts and are not replaced or reclassified by this fee-schedule gate.
